messages:
Ivy Nguyen: Quick request — ACME asked for a 1-page "Activation Feedback Card" we can hand customers during enablement. It should be super short and focus on: prefill, batching, streaming, and a one-click feedback capture.
Ravi Desai: Sounds good. Keep it customer-facing: 4 action bullets, 1 curl example, jitter suggestion, 3 simple metrics, and a tiny feedback widget idea.
Camila Ortiz: For metrics use plain names: prefill_success_pct, stream_p90_ms, inflight_count. Include suggested thresholds customers can paste into monitoring.
Ivy Nguyen: Also add a renewal-signal note: if prefill_success_pct < 60% OR stream_p90_ms > 800ms for 48h mark as "Needs Attention" and offer troubleshooting call.
Eli Brooks: One-liner curl they can copy:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant":"ACME","templates":["welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
Jitter: schedule every 5m +/- rand(0..45s).
Ravi Desai: Action bullets I'll draft: 1) One-off prefill top 6 prompts; 2) Batch size 2-4 for low-latency apps; 3) Client timeout = 12s then fallback to streaming with max_chunk_tokens=64; 4) Cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=1h, static=12h.
Camila Ortiz: Health legend (copyable): GREEN = prefill_success_pct >= 75% AND stream_p90_ms < 500ms; YELLOW = prefill_success_pct 60-75% OR stream_p90_ms 500-800ms; RED = prefill_success_pct < 60% OR stream_p90_ms > 800ms OR sustained errors.
Ivy Nguyen: Feedback widget idea: thumbs up / thumbs down + single-line "what changed". Responses append to renewal notes.
OpsBot: Draft uploaded internally: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/activation-feedback-card-draft — remember to replace internal contacts with support@redwood.ai for public copy.
Eli Brooks: I'll assemble the doc and a 2-line email template: subject + 3 bullets (what we saw, quick actions, link).
Ravi Desai: Add a short appendix for shared-hosted: how to request a temporary warm pool (support@redwood.ai, include tenant id, expected QPS, start/end).
Ivy Nguyen: Great. Target: publish to CS enablement repo by tomorrow morning. Post public link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
